headline: Microsoft confirms November security update fails on some Windows 11 PCs
summary: Microsoft confirmed that the November 2026 security update is failing to install on Windows 11 systems that already have the October preview update. A fix is reportedly on the way.

claims.statement: Microsoft confirmed the November 2026 security update fails to install on Windows 11 systems with the October preview update.

sources.quote: the November 2026 security updates are failing to install on Windows 11 systems with the October preview update
This month’s security update is failing on some systems already running the preview update released in October

claims.statement: A fix for the installation failure is reportedly forthcoming.
